metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2025 · Adolescence
metas.description: When a 13-year-old is accused of the murder of a classmate, his family, therapist and the detective in charge are all left asking what really happened.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2025 · American Primeval
metas.description: It follows the gritty and adventurous exploration of the birth of the American West, the violent collisions of cults, religion, and men and women fighting for control of the new world.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2025 · Zero Day
metas.description: In the midst of crisis, how can we discover the truth when it seems the world is being destroyed by uncontrollable forces? And to what extent are conspiracy theories our own inventions or products of our imagination?

metas.name: ★ 6.8 · 2026 · Something Very Bad Is Going to Happen
metas.description: A certain atmosphere of horror is felt the week before the celebration of an unfortunate wedding.

metas.name: ★ 5.9 · 2025 · Wayward
metas.description: A bucolic but sinister town explores the insidious intricacies of the troubled teen industry, and the eternal struggle of the next generation.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2026 · Legends
metas.description: Customs agents go undercover to infiltrate Britain's most dangerous drug gangs, following a thrilling criminal investigation based on extensive research and interviews with those involved in the top-secret operation.

metas.name: ★ 6.8 · 2025 · The Hunting Wives
metas.description: Sophie O'Neil moves to deep East Texas and succumbs to socialite Margo's charms. Her life is soon consumed by obsession, seduction, and murder.

metas.name: ★ 6.9 · 2026 · Berlin and the Lady with an Ermine
metas.description: Berlin reunites his crew in Seville for an elaborate con targeting a powerful duke and his wife who've made the mistake of trying to blackmail him. Their plan involves faking the theft of a priceless painting as cover.

metas.name: ★ 5.7 · 2025 · Billionaires' Bunker
metas.description: When World War III is about to break out, a group of billionaires takes refuge in a luxury bunker. Through screens, they watch the spectacle of the world they knew collapsing above their heads.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2026 · If Wishes Could Kill
metas.description: Follows five friends in high school who receive a death warning from a mysterious wish-granting app. As they struggle to escape their fates, they uncover chilling truths that connect the app to the sudden death of a classmate.

metas.name: ★ 7.0 · 2025 · The Asset
metas.description: Agent Tea infiltrates a criminal gang, befriending Ashley, the girlfriend of ringleader Miran. Witnessing Ashley's stark reality, Tea is torn between her mission and a desire to help her escape Miran's control.

metas.name: ★ 6.2 · 2026 · Unchosen
metas.description: Rosie is a devoted wife and mother in a conservative Christian cult, and her meeting with escaped convict Sam triggers her dangerous journey toward freedom and sexual discovery.

metas.name: ★ 6.4 · 2026 · Below
metas.description: When a mysterious sea creature terrorizes a remote town, a fisherman must fight to protect his family, his community, and his way of life.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2025 · Karma
metas.description: Bound by their harrowing destinies, a physician plagued by nightmares, a man shaken after his world was unexpectedly disrupted and a debtor drowning in private loans become caught in inescapable circumstances.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2026 · Taskaree: The Smuggler's Web
metas.description: At customs, Superintendent Meena's elite team faces a crucial mission: stop rising contraband trafficking and take down global crime boss Bada Choudhary's syndicate.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2026 · Radioactive Emergency
metas.description: In 1987 Brazil, scavengers discover a mysterious glowing substance in an abandoned hospital. As the material changes hands, scientists and doctors desperately work to prevent a radioactive disaster from claiming countless lives.

metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 2026 · Blood Sacrifice
metas.description: A Stockholm detective must team up with his estranged ex-cop father to catch a serial killer targeting police officers, forcing them to resolve their differences during the investigation.

metas.name: ★ 6.5 · 2025 · Caught
metas.description: In Bariloche, reporter Ema Garay's online exposes unveil tax dodgers. Her probe into a 16-year-old's disappearance points to Leo Mercer, upending both their lives.
